original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日尔州武装分子绑架14名伊斯兰学校学生
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚尼日尔州拉菲地方政府区潘多加里，疑似武装匪徒绑架了14名伊斯兰学校学生及其教师。据称，这些学生是在教师农场帮忙收割玉米时被掳走。尼日尔州警方发言人证实了此事，并澄清被绑学生为14人，而非部分报道所称的50人。目前该事件为单一来源报道。

location.raw_text: Pandogari, Rafi Local Government Area of Niger State; Tungan-Bako village

key_facts.fact: 疑似武装匪徒在尼日尔州拉菲地方政府区绑架14名伊斯兰学校学生
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Suspected bandits have abducted 14 students of an Islamic school in Pandogari, Rafi Local Government Area of Niger State.

key_facts.fact: 学生据称在教师农场帮忙收割玉米时被绑架
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The students were reportedly abducted on Saturday while helping their teacher, also known as a Mallam, harvest maize on his farm in Tungan-Bako village.

key_facts.fact: 尼日尔州警方发言人证实事件，并澄清被绑学生为14人而非50人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Police Public Relations Officer of the Niger State Command, Wasiu Abiodun, confirmed the incident on Monday, clarifying that 14 students were abducted and not 50, as reported in some quarters.

uncertainties: 作案者身份仅为疑似武装匪徒，尚未确认
事件目前仅有一个来源（Punch）报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
被绑人数存在不同说法，警方称14人，部分报道称50人
